agents.name: Scout
agents.role: Inspect the problem and context. Report requirements and constraints. Do not edit files.

agents.name: Builder
agents.role: Develop a concrete solution. Implement files when writes are enabled and report what you verified.

agents.name: Critic
agents.role: Review both contributions for concrete defects and missing evidence. Do not edit files.

agents.name: Lead
agents.role: Combine the contributions into one useful final answer. Address the review findings. Do not edit files.
